scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by an explicit global elementary-collapse scheme, not by extrapolating finite examples. Homology is computed over the integers using surface cohomology and integral combinatorial Alexander duality. No independence of evaluation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires triangle-free closed cellular quadrangulation, every four-cycle facial, no K_{2,3}, and at least eight vertices; classifies original ordinary cut-complex integral homology and the dual homotopy type, not original homotopy type or equivariance. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be eliminated.
title: Surface quadrangulations force integral orientability torsion in ordinary three-cut complexes
